2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a user interface of a device at the subscriber's location__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription tier or service package information specific to the subscriber__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber directly from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication channel__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is maintained separately from the EPG provider's data__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and storing the filtered EPG information in a local cache__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

7. (Currently Amended) An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __that is independent of and separate from the content delivery provider__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider __by cross-referencing subscriber entitlements against EPG channel listings__.

8. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __in a customized format based on the subscriber's channel accessibility__.

9. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __from subscriber account data maintained by the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

10. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __in a format distinct from EPG provider data structures__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is generated and maintained locally on the machine__.

11. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __from the independent EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and storing results in a filtered EPG database__.

14. (Currently Amended) The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a display device associated with the subscriber__.
